CustomField.inlineHelpText: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical input that produced this Quote's current document tables (definitions, groupings, quote and line values). A fresh digest matching this one means nothing that affects output has changed, so generation can safely reuse the existing Ready tables instead of rebuilding them. See specs/quote-docusign-launch/spec.md Increment 2.
CustomField.label: Document Data Fingerprint
